'''Harman Rike''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] agent of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] who was active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by an [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] on [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha]] before [[Andronikos Revel]] could kill him himself.
